description.value: Stinky's on the Stroll is a legendary neighborhood pub on Whistler's Village Stroll, conceived by long-time local Jeremy 'Stinky' Peterson as a community gathering place and love letter to the town. Repeatedly voted Locals' Favourite Hangout in Best of Whistler polls, it doubles as a living museum of Whistler sports and music memorabilia. The kitchen focuses on inventive sandwiches and comfort food alongside craft beers, local brews, and cocktails.
